QA local patch and validation note, 2026-05-01 10:38 EDT.

Changed `ios/Handrail/Handrail/Views/IPad/IPadDashboardWorkspaceView.swift` so Active Chats rows derive their leading icon/color from status: `waiting_for_approval` now uses `exclamationmark.triangle.fill` with purple instead of the hard-coded green `play.fill`; running chats still use green `play.fill`.

Verification performed:
- XcodeBuildMCP `test_sim` on iPad Pro 13-inch (M5), iOS Simulator 26.4.1, with `-only-testing:HandrailTests/ChatListQueryTests`, `-only-testing:HandrailTests/HandrailCommandAvailabilityTests`, and `-only-testing:HandrailTests/RootLayoutSelectionTests`: 29/29 passed.
- XcodeBuildMCP `build_run_sim` for scheme `Handrail` on iPad Pro 13-inch (M5), iOS Simulator 26.4.1: build, install, and launch succeeded.
- Screenshot captured at `test-artifacts/qa-lead-issue24-2026-05-01/01-ipad-dashboard-after-active-row-patch.jpg`.

Not closing yet: the launched simulator state had running active chats but no waiting-approval chat, and shell `simctl` seeding was blocked by CoreSimulator service access in this automation sandbox. Exact visible approval-row confirmation remains the remaining evidence needed.

Lead Dev validation update, 2026-05-01 20:24 UTC.

The local branch contains the narrow #24 code fix in `ios/Handrail/Handrail/Views/IPad/IPadDashboardWorkspaceView.swift`: Active Chats no longer uses a hard-coded green `play.fill`; it now derives `activeIcon(for:)` and `activeColor(for:)` from status. `waiting_for_approval` maps to `exclamationmark.triangle.fill` and purple, while `running` remains green `play.fill`.

Verification performed in this run:
- `node cli/dist/src/index.js chats` against the live local server returned running and completed chats only; no `waiting_for_approval` chat was available.
- XcodeBuildMCP `test_sim` on iPad Pro 13-inch (M5), iOS Simulator 26.4.1, for `HandrailTests/RootLayoutSelectionTests` and `HandrailTests/ChatListQueryTests`: 22/22 passed.
- XcodeBuildMCP `build_run_sim` for scheme `Handrail` on iPad Pro 13-inch (M5): build, install, and launch succeeded.
- XcodeBuildMCP `snapshot_ui` confirmed the iPad Dashboard mounted with paired Mac state, Active Chats, Attention Queue, and Recent Outcomes.
- XcodeBuildMCP screenshot: `/var/folders/k_/spz3zlj566sc4qh29g0tk6jh0000gn/T/screenshot_optimized_46c3c734-678e-416f-9df6-bcef3ab5af70.jpg`.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Remaining blocker before closure: exact visible approval-row confirmation still needs a safe live `waiting_for_approval` chat in the simulator-connected Desktop feed. I did not create an app-server thread, stop or alter live Codex work, overwrite simulator pairing state, or add a test-only launch injection path solely to fabricate that UI condition.

QA live-data root-cause run, 2026-05-01:

The controlled read-only approval repro did not produce a live approval condition. The same Desktop routing failure occurred before the approval prompt could run, so no `approval_required` message and no `waiting_for_approval` chat-list row reached iOS. iPad Attention showed no approval row.

Evidence/report: `docs/team/outputs/live-data-root-cause.md`, `test-artifacts/live-data-root-cause-20260501T230015Z/server-messages.ndjson`, and `test-artifacts/live-data-root-cause-20260501T230015Z/04-ipad-attention-after-approval-repro.jpg`.

Classification: live condition not produced in this repro. Static code inspection also shows the current CLI does not map Desktop rollout/log data into `waiting_for_approval`, and `approve`/`deny` still throw, so approval ingestion remains a separate likely root cause after the Desktop start handoff is fixed.

QA gate update, 2026-05-02T08:39Z:

#29, #21, and #22 are now closed with live evidence. I reviewed the current post-#29 state for this issue.

Current result:
- `node cli/dist/src/index.js chats` shows running, idle, and completed chats, but no `waiting_for_approval` chat row.
- Static inspection still shows `ChatManager.approve()` and `ChatManager.deny()` throw `Approval routing for Codex chat <id> is not enabled yet.`
- The iPad Dashboard style fix for `waiting_for_approval` still cannot be closed against real data because the local live feed has not produced first-class approval state yet.

Conclusion: #24 remains open and blocked by #2. Closure still requires a live simulator-connected approval state, screenshot evidence, the live chat id, and confirmation that the Dashboard row renders approval state rather than a green running state. No fixture state or test-only launch injection should be used for closure evidence.

Marked blocked per Lead Dev selection rule update. Current blocker: #24 cannot be closed with real acceptance evidence until #2 provides first-class Codex Desktop/app-server approval request IDs and the live Handrail feed can produce a real waiting_for_approval row. Lead Dev should skip this issue unless explicitly asked to work blocked issues.

PM dependency reconciliation 2026-05-02T23:13Z:

#24 remains blocked, but the dependency is now more precise. #2 has code/spec/test coverage for first-class approval request ids, app-server approve/deny responses, and approval-state `chat_list` broadcasts. The missing evidence is live, not architectural: the running local server must expose the rebuilt CLI and produce a real simulator-connected `waiting_for_approval` row from a Handrail-started Codex Desktop/app-server turn.

Closure contract for this issue remains unchanged: capture the iPad Dashboard row from that real live state, record the chat id and screenshot path, and confirm it renders as approval state rather than green running state. Do not use fixture-only state or product launch injection to satisfy this.
